About the Position

A 3-4 year funded PhD (CDT) focusing on 2D materials, advanced materials, energy, and electronics. Hosted by University of Cambridge in Cambridge. Apply by Applications for 2027 intake are now open.

OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentship: 2D Materials of Tomorrow EPSRC CDT
HostUniversity of Cambridge
LocationCambridge, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
StipendFully Funded
Application Deadline14 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Basic Information

  • Host Institution: University of Cambridge
  • Type: 3-4 year funded PhD (CDT)
  • Area: 2D materials, advanced materials, energy, electronics
  • Status: Applications for 2027 intake are now open
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded

Project Overview

A 3-4 year funded PhD (CDT) focusing on 2D materials, advanced materials, energy, and electronics.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/courses/directory/egegpdtwo

Source: postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 14 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About University of Cambridge

The University of Cambridge is a collegiate research university in Cambridge, England, founded in 1209. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across the sciences, engineering, humanities and social sciences. Its departments, research institutes and colleges support academic inquiry and international collaboration, providing a setting for advanced study and scholarship.

Official website: https://www.cam.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Via Postgraduate Course Directory entry for "2D Materials of Tomorrow EPSRC CDT PhD". Apply to the programme, then choose/develop a project with supervisors.

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.
